description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 145. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 90 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Big Bang Attack and Final
Flash
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: self (150 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Beam
The user forms two Big Bang Attacks in his hands
and put them together forming a larger blue version of
the Final Flash.
Targets in this 5 ft wide, 150 foot long line must make
a dexterity saving throw taking 12d12 Ki Damage on a
fail, half on a success.
